annotation_rule: At least three answers and unanimous yes/no for a recording and exact source question.
exclusion_rule: Exclude all pilot and fresh-validation recordings, plus the 336 added training recordings reconstructed from the released train_large selection.
pair_rule: Lowercase, normalize whitespace, and strip terminal punctuation. Drop recording/stem combinations with both labels after normalization. Select one opposite-label recording pair per stem in seeded shuffled order without reusing recordings.

primary.contrast: Learned K=16 minus learned K=4 within-stem pair preference, averaging fixed checkpoint seeds and both answer orders within each pair. Ties score one half.

secondary: Fixed mean pooling at K=4 and K=16
